item.title: Quantum X Labs Launches Qatacomb for Quantum Security Research
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Quantum X Labs Inc. (Nasdaq: QXL) (“QuantumX Labs” or the “Company”), today announced the launch of Qatacomb, a new research initiative being advanced through the Company’s QuantumQ Security operation, focused on exploring a quantum-native approach to protecting sensitive information.
